build.method: Original PlatformIO builder with verified upstream packages and local cloud overrides

validation.certificate_checks: RSA/ECC accepted; wrong hostname, expired, untrusted and tampered certificates rejected in native BearSSL tests
validation.clock_checks: 6 native groups: Wi-Fi startup, retry intervals, reconnect/manual retry, millis wraparound, browser epoch validation, HTTP Date validation
validation.pinned_tls: Real OpenSSL/BearSSL TLS 1.2 handshakes: matching RSA, P-256, P-384 and P-521 keys accepted without clock/CA despite expired self-signed certificates; different keys rejected
validation.pin_export: Verified TLS export succeeds; expired, untrusted and wrong-host certificates rejected
validation.external_api_smoke_test: Nightscout v1 returned HTTP 200 without token and a Date header; compatible SGV JSON; no glucose values retained

setup.password: Generated on-device and shown on the display

tls_authentication.default: Public CA chain, hostname and certificate date validation; requires a valid clock
tls_authentication.optional: Explicit server public-key pin; TLS proof of key possession without CA chain/hostname/certificate date checks
tls_authentication.clock_bootstrap: Fresh HTTP Date after a successful pinned HTTPS request only; never from a glucose reading or unverified HTTP
